name: overseas-lead-research
title_zh: 海外询盘先查公司再回信，顺手把广告主档案补全
tagline_zh: Facebook 表单里公司名拼写五花八门、邮箱还是 gmail，直接报价容易踩空。
tagline_en: Messy Facebook form names and gmail addresses make blind quotes risky. It matches each lead against your.
desc_en: Research overseas B2B leads from irregular Facebook/Instagram forms, customer replies and company/product materials. Reuse advertiser MD archives, verify customer identity and business, assess campaign fit, score follow-up priority and draft sourced outreach. Use for 海外客户背调、询盘匹配、客户开发分级 and advertiser-profile updates.
why_zh: 不是查一次就丢：每轮背调结果回写广告主 MD 档案，下一批询盘自动复用，越用越准。
why_en: Not a one-shot lookup: every research pass writes back into the advertiser MD archive, so the next batch of leads reuses it and.
limit_zh: 只处理 Facebook/Instagram 表单、客户回信和公司产品资料这三类输入，其他渠道的线索它不认。
limit_en: Only handles Facebook/Instagram forms, customer replies and company materials; needs an existing advertiser MD archive to compare against, otherwise.
title_en: Verify overseas leads before you reply, then update the.
